Chapter 5940: Be A Good Emperor, Don’T Play Dirty

Chapter 5940: Be A Good Emperor, Don’t Play Dirty

The scene fell into a deathly silence. Demon Moon Saber Saint herself lost her composure.

Only Chu Zhu shook her head and smiled wryly. The flood tiger was on a different level.

She couldn’t determine the true ceiling of the tiger. Nevertheless, she believed it could devour emperors and desolate gods just as easily.

Spectators were already amazed by the ferocious tiger after seeing the dead inspectors. They didn’t expect it to defeat pseudo-emperors so easily as well.

These were beings eligible to obtain dao fruits and become Grand Emperors. They stood at the apex and could only be seen from afar.

Today, this dog-like creature crushed them in just a single move. It looked docile and tamed while next to Li Qiye while the truth was anything but.

“What are you?!” The twins bellowed.

They understood their place on the ladder - far from being unbeatable. Nevertheless, they had roamed the world under the banner of Immortal Suppression. Sure, a Grand Emperor or Ancestor could easily defeat them, but not an unknown creature.

Moon Demon stood there in a daze since that could also be her being stomped on by the dog.

“Raa!” The flood tiger opened its mouth fully, revealing the eight separate flesh petals full of teeth.

“What the hell?!” Being stomped alone didn’t frighten the twins, but this horrific sight up close got the best of them.

Anyone would be horrified by this due to the disconnect between the cute dog and the monstrous jaw.

“Seems like it’s still hungry.” Li Qiye commented.

This comment exacerbated the twins’ fear. One of them shouted: “Just kill, enough of this unnecessary humiliation!”

“It has nothing to do with me, you’re its prey.” Li Qiye shrugged.

The twins were pale because although they weren’t afraid of death, being devoured by a monster still invoked a primal fear.

The crowd noticed how this mortal was controlling the insanely powerful monster. This naturally confused them.

“Our dynasty will not forgive you for this humiliation!” The other twin shouted.

Both wanted to die a swift death, not being eaten like this.

“I don’t care about your dynasty.” Li Qiye smiled and asked: “Hey, they don’t want to be eaten. What say you?”

“Oo-” The tiger opened its mouth wider and the teeth seemed to be squirming.

Anyone facing this jaw would be traumatized for the rest of their lives if they were lucky enough to survive the encounter.

“Enough!” A majestic figure crushed the spatial fabrics, creating an opening.

An imperial aura surged causing debris to go flying. Trees were destroyed and boulders exploded. Mountains trembled violently before the cultivator’s wrath.

“A Grand Emperor!” Everyone became alarmed.

The imperial aura surged forward and made it unbearable for the crowd. One after another fell to the ground.

As a pseudo-emperor, Demon Moon still had a long way to go compared to the real thing. Therefore, she fell from the sky.

“Clank!” A colossal sword materialized through space and time, cleaving through mountains along the way before reaching the flood tiger.

It was unique with a flat tip, looking like an elongated iron plate from a distance. The blade seemed to be wrapped by iron thorns, so it looked rather dull and heavy. Nevertheless, it was accompanied by a flame as red as blood. It left a trail of fire in its wake, burning all the trees beneath into ashes.

“Iron Thorns Grand Emperor!” The blade shared the same name as its master.

Those who remained standing from the aura dropped to the ground after recognizing the Grand Emperor.

“Be a good emperor, don’t play dirty.” Li Qiye shook his head and casually waved his hand, causing the ten bracelets to fly into the air.

“Boom!” The divine light emanating from them blinded the crowd.
